cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility Normally
cases.description: Verify that clicking the toggle button (data-testid="toggle-button") when the text box is initially hidden adds the 'show' class to make the text box (data-testid="text-box") visible, and clicking it again removes the 'show' class to hide it.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button (data-testid="toggle-button") are handled reliably and the final visibility state of the text box (data-testid="text-box") accurately reflects the last user action without inconsistency.

cases.title: Hide visible text box using Close button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class from the element (data-testid='text-box').

cases.title: Toggle and close text box workflow
cases.description: Verify the complete cycle of opening the text box using the toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button') and subsequently closing it using the close button (data-testid='close-button'), ensuring the 'show' class is properly added and removed.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that opening the text box using the toggle button invokes getVoices and populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with available voices showing names and languages.

cases.title: Dynamic Voice Update on voiceschanged Event
cases.description: Verify that the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the voice dropdown options accordingly when available voices change.

cases.title: Assign Selected Voice to Speech Message
cases.description: Verify that when a user selects a voice from the populated dropdown, the selected voice is correctly assigned to message.voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Handle Empty Voices Array from Web Speech API
cases.description: Verify that the system handles empty voice lists gracefully when speechSynthesis.getVoices() returns no available voices upon text box opening.

cases.title: Select valid voice from dropdown with language codes
cases.description: Verify that selecting a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') correctly sets the chosen voice for speech synthesis, supporting specific language codes like 'CN' or 'US'.

cases.title: Multiple voice selections updates active voice
cases.description: Verify that performing multiple successive voice selections in the dropdown correctly updates and ensures the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Dropdown populated on page load
cases.description: Verify that the dropdown is populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded prior to user selection.

cases.title: Select invalid or removed voice option
cases.description: Verify system behavior when an invalid or removed voice option is selected from the dropdown, ensuring graceful handling without crashing speech synthesis.

cases.title: Read text aloud using selected voice and text input
cases.description: Verify that when the user toggles the text box open, enters text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'), selects a voice from the dropdown (data-testid='voice-select'), and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system successfully reads the entered text aloud using the selected voice.

cases.title: Attempt to read empty textarea or unselected voice
cases.description: Verify the boundary and edge handling when the user attempts to click the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button') while the textarea is empty or no voice is explicitly chosen.

cases.title: Handle speech synthesis API failure during reading
cases.description: Verify that the system gracefully handles abnormal conditions such as a speech synthesis API failure or exception triggered when the 'Read Text' button is clicked.

cases.title: Normal click on a predefined phrase box triggers speech and active highlight
cases.description: Verify that clicking a predefined phrase box in the main section reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Sequential clicks across different predefined phrase boxes
cases.description: Verify that clicking different phrase boxes sequentially correctly triggers speech playback and visual highlights for each selected box without state interference.

cases.title: Rapid repeated clicks on the same predefined phrase box
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box accurately trigger speech and visual feedback for each interaction without breaking the component state.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover the required edge cases and normal workflows, and directly map to the provided requirements without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1: Normal scenario - Click toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button') to show the hidden text-box (data-testid='text-box') via 'show' class addition. Click again to hide it. Edge/Boundary scenario - Rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button. Abnormal scenario - None identified. Actionable missing scenarios - Rapid click stress test consistency check. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2: Normal scenario - Click close button (data-testid='close-button') inside visible text box to hide it by removing the 'show' class. Edge scenario - Click close button when text box is already hidden. Abnormal scenario - None. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3: Normal scenario - Open text box via toggle button, trigger getVoices and populate voice-select (data-testid='voice-select') dropdown. Edge scenario - Handle 'voiceschanged' event dynamically updating options. Abnormal scenario - Web Speech API returns empty voices array. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4: Normal scenario - Select a voice from voice-select dropdown containing language codes like 'CN' or 'US'. Edge scenario - Multiple successive voice selections ensuring the last one is active. Abnormal scenario - Selecting an invalid or removed voice option. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5: Normal scenario - Enter text into textarea (data-testid='text-area'), select voice, and click 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'). Edge scenario - Read empty textarea or unselected voice. Abnormal scenario - Speech synthesis API failure during reading. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6: Normal scenario - Click predefined phrase box to read text aloud and highlight with 'active' class for 800ms. Edge scenario - Rapid sequential clicks across different boxes or repeated clicks on the same box. Abnormal scenario - Missing image or text data in phrase box array.
